title: The first AI agent that trains itself
description:
Comment "HERMES" and I'll send you the link.

The first cloud AI agent that actually trains itself — MaxHermes by @minimax_ai. It's the cloud version of Hermes Agent, the open-source framework with 90K+ stars on GitHub, powered by MiniMax M2.7. No API, no setup. You give it a task, it completes it, then writes itself an instruction on how to do it faster next time. Tell it once "every morning send me the top AI news to Telegram" — next morning it just runs, in your style, from sources you trust. Same agent works on Telegram, Slack, Discord, WhatsApp — same memory everywhere. Plus 10,000+ pre-built experts inside.

Check my bio to try MiniMax Agent.

#MaxHermes #MiniMax #MiniMaxAgent #AITools #AIThatLearns
